statement.p: To estimate the health of the Rocky Mountain elk population in the Wenaha Wildlife Area, the Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife caught, tagged, and released 31 Rocky Mountain elk. A month later, they returned and observed 38 Rocky Mountain elk, 13 of which had tags. Approximately how many Rocky Mountain elk are in the Wenaha Wildlife Area?

solution.p: Let x represent how many elk are in the Wenaha Wildlife Area. We set up a proportional equation: \begin{aligned} \frac{\text{tagged elk}}{\text{total elk}} \amp= \frac{\text{tagged elk}}{\text{total elk}}\\ \frac{13}{38} \amp= \frac{31}{x}\\ \frac{13}{38} \multiplyright{38\cdot x} \amp= \frac{31}{x}\multiplyright{38\cdot x}\\ 13 \cdot x \amp= 31\cdot 38\\ \divideunder{13 \cdot x}{13} \amp= \divideunder{31\cdot 38}{13}\\ x \amp= 91 \end{aligned} There are approximately 91 elk in the Wenaha Wildlife Area.
